Params: {3: "Through the relentless blizzard, you finally traverse the endless snowfields, arriving at the theater's entrance."}
{3: 'With a heavy groan, you force the doors open. Impenetrable darkness waits within, thick as undiluted ink.'}
{3: 'You raise your candle, and its small sphere of light pushes back the suffocating shadows. As far as you can see, the theater lies in complete ruin.'}
{3: 'With your flame as a spark, you begin lighting the candles along your path.'}
{3: 'Light now emanates from you, following your footsteps and illuminating a trail through the wreckage—a path toward Bianca.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'And then, you find her. The silhouette you have been searching for. She rests before you, her head gently inclined against a theater seat, lost in a profound slumber.'}
{3: 'In the flickering candlelight, you sit beside her. Your hand moves to gently brush aside the hair that veils her cheek, revealing a face of perfect peace.'}
{3: 'Her soul has slumbered here for an age, waiting for your call to return.'}
{3: 'Her breathing remains gentle as a feather, steady and faint. She lingers at the threshold of her dream, deaf to your voice.'}
{3: 'You take her hand in yours. It is as cold as the heart of the blizzard raging outside.'}
{3: 'Determined, you trace the familiar symbol onto her palm—a pattern she knows intimately—forging a connection with her consciousness as it drifts in the dreamscape.'}
{3: 'Your finger glides across her skin, again and again. In this phantom theater of memories and ruin, your touch is the only anchor, the only thing that is real.'}
{3: 'After what feels like an eternity, the hand nestled in yours finally begins to warm.'}
{1: '"With what you cherish in your heart, write an oath that belongs only to us."', 2: 'ffffffff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 7: '-3', 10: '1'}
{1: '"No matter how the seasons change, or the years turn..."', 2: 'ffffffff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 7: '-1', 10: '1'}
{1: '"Nothing in this world shall ever tear us apart."', 2: 'ffffffff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 7: '-1', 9: '1', 10: '1'}
{3: "The vow you once made when tracing that symbol into each other's palms still echoes by your ear."}
{3: 'Piercing through the layers of the dream, it finds her in the deepest corners. Now, that timeless promise echoes once again by her ear.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'In the candlelight, her eyelashes flutter, delicate shadows dancing like butterfly wings upon her cheeks.'}
{3: 'You tenderly grasp her ice-cold hand and press her palm to your cheek, letting her feel the warmth that is yours and yours alone.'}
{3: 'At last, a fragile warmth returns to her fingertips.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'After a long moment, a soft murmur escapes her lips. Her eyes, heavy with the weight of a long slumber, finally open.'}
{3: 'Her gaze drifts, unfocused, slowly taking in the world until it settles on you.'}
{3: 'As recognition dawns, the haze in her eyes sharpens into pure, disbelieving wonder.'}
{3: 'For a long moment, she is perfectly still, her hand clasping yours as if it were the only real thing in the world.'}
{3: 'Then, tears glisten in her eyes. She raises a hand to your cheek, her touch tracing the landscape of your face with a tender, aching longing.'}
{3: 'She holds your gaze, searching, until a certainty dawns within her. The hesitation shatters, and her smile breaks through—as radiant as the day you first met.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'The blizzard was relentless on my journey here.', 4: '101', 18: '100014750', 19: '1', 21: 'v420bianka'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Did you find it too cold to bear?', 4: '101', 18: '100014751', 19: '1', 21: 'v420bianka'}
{3: 'With that smile, she reaches out to gently brush the snow from your shoulders.'}
{3: 'Then, she pulls you into a tight embrace, a silent testament to the long separation you have both endured.'}
{3: 'As you push open the long-sealed theater doors, the blizzard has ceased, revealing a sky of perfect, pristine azure.'}
{3: 'You hold her hand tightly, setting out together on the same path that led you to her, but this time, you are finally heading home.'}
